items.excerpt: A coding agent can write the markup and ship a page in seconds, but it can't see what it made. Design Diff proposes a visual feedback loop that hands agents a screenshot-level comparison against the intended design.
Figma demos its new Eraser tool and updated Fill tool on canvas, part of the post-Config wave of direct-manipulation drawing features.

Ask an LLM to 'make this landing page look like a high-end Swiss design studio' and you get mush. The author's fix: give the model a machine-readable design library of tokens and components it can actually read.
Autodesk Flow Studio's new 3D Editor + Canvas combines interactive 3D scene construction with generative 2D video models, making AI filmmaking directable instead of prompt-and-pray.
Weekly CG tool roundup covering Meshy 7's image-to-3D generative model, Gaussian splat app Postshot, and Topaz Labs' AI-powered VFX tools.
Miris brings adaptive-streaming logic to 3D: one source asset streams to any device at the right fidelity, changing how designers ship heavy 3D content to the web.
Marvelous Designer 2026.1 adds a Seamline Ripping Tool plus Brush Pinching and Pinching Simulation Override, giving garment and character artists far finer control over cloth.
Simulation firm 51WORLD unveiled two embodied-AI products built on its digital-twin engine, pushing synthetic 3D environments into robot training and product validation.
Walmart is 3D printing store structures with Alquist and FGMI, a fabrication shift that pulls computational design and robotic construction into mainstream retail architecture.

A newly granted Arm patent describes a headset that analyzes on-screen motion and fires ultrasonic transducers at the inner ear to cancel XR motion sickness — a hardware-level comfort primitive for spatial designers.
Everything known so far about Project Phoenix, Meta's next headset — display stack, form factor and the interaction model it implies for spatial app designers.
Designer Fund's Ben Blumenrose argues the floor for AI-generated website design is rising fast, and that the scarce human job is now supplying taste — the judgment about what 'good enough' means.
Architecture may be one of AI's hardest domains: the drawings and design rationale that would train a model sit locked inside firms, and Anthropic and other labs can't reach them.
Anthropic's new Claude tag update lets its Slack agent read a whole channel conversation and jump in unprompted — a bet that the bottleneck in enterprise AI is that people still use AI alone.
The teams getting real value from AI agents are deliberately narrowing autonomy — scoping what an agent may do alone and where a human must approve, a pattern design orgs can copy.
Context engineering hits a wall when the underlying documents are messy: agent reliability tracks the quality of the source material, not the model.
UX Collective's weekly roundup on how to become an 'AI designer' and what vibe-coded portfolios are doing to hiring and craft expectations.
The classic ad-agency workflow still shapes how UX teams run projects; the author argues it breaks down in an era of AI agents and systems thinking, and proposes a redefinition.
Rigid voice grammars make the human do the translating. A case study in replacing fixed commands with LLM intent parsing — and what that means for interface design.
As teams spin up agents everywhere, tech leaders are recalibrating governance to keep token usage and cost in check without stifling the experimentation designers and builders rely on.
Meta's new app Pocket replaces photos and reels with AI-generated playable games — social vibe coding as a consumer format, and a new surface designers may have to design for.
AI-slop picture books are flooding shelves; illustrators and parents describe what generative art is doing to a craft built on hand-made visual storytelling.
Two Minute Papers breaks down a small AI model that punches far above its size class, and why compact models matter for local creative tooling.
A quick look at an AI system that generates explorable 3D worlds from a prompt — world models arriving as a concepting tool for designers.
